description.p: Sortl tidies a messy folder such as Downloads by sorting its files into category folders like Images, Documents, and Archives. You see exactly what will move before anything changes.
Built to be careful with your files:

ul.li: Preview every move before you confirm
Files are never overwritten; name clashes are skipped
Each move is verified and recorded in a history
An integrity check can inspect any interrupted operation without changing files

screenshot.caption: Preview every move before anything changes
Review what was moved and check integrity

description.p: First release: choose a folder, preview the plan, organize, and review history.
